info.name: Creates a GCS bucket secret according to specified parameters.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to create secret in.

params.name: remote
params.description: The remote name must contain only lowercase letters, digits or dashes, must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit and must be no more than 30 characters in length. The created secret will be named {remote}-bucket-envvars or {remote}-bucket-params, for Core 1 or Core 2, respectively.

params.name: secretVersion
params.description: The version of the secret to use (CORE_V1 or CORE_V2). Default value is CORE_V1

items.docs: Creates a GCS bucket secret according to specified parameters.

info.name: Creates a generic rclone bucket secret according to specified parameters.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to create secret in.

params.name: remote
params.description: The remote name must contain only lowercase letters, digits or dashes, must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit and must be no more than 30 characters in length. The created secret will be named {remote}-bucket-envvars or {remote}-bucket-params, for Core 1 or Core 2, respectively.

params.name: format
params.description: The format for the secret. Must be one of (env_var, config_param). env_var formats the secret as environment variables, each with a key and a value. env_var is suitable for Seldon Core v1 and Argo Workflows. config_param formats the secret to be compatible with Rclone's HTTP API. config_param is suitable for Seldon Core v2.

info.name: Lists the names and metadata of secrets used by Seldon Deploy.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to list secrets in.

params.name: secretType
params.description: The secret type, can be one of (`bucket`, `registry`) or `all` to list all secrets used by Seldon Deploy.

params.name: bucketSecretFormat
params.description: Optional filter for the format of bucket secrets. Only applicable when `secret_type` is `bucket.`

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Optional The maximum number of Secrets to return in the response.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Optional pagination token returned from a previous call to List that indicates where this listing should continue from.

params.name: search
params.description: Optional search string for secrets.
